Definition: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
BiblicalUsage: 1) not, no; 1a) not (with verb-absolute prohibition); 1b) not (with modifier-negation); 1c) nothing (subst); 1d) without (with particle); 1e) before (of time)
